name: Training Workshop
description: Workshop and training session summary template covering learning goals, activities, participation, and follow-ups.

sections.title: Session Details
sections.instruction: Workshop title, date, facilitator, audience, duration, location or modality

sections.title: Learning Objectives
sections.instruction: List the intended learning outcomes or skills covered in the session

sections.title: Agenda & Activities
sections.instruction: Summarize modules, exercises, demos, discussions, and timing if mentioned

sections.title: Participant Questions
sections.instruction: Capture notable participant questions, answers given, and any unresolved questions

sections.title: Key Takeaways
sections.instruction: Summarize the main concepts, practices, or decisions participants should retain

sections.title: Materials & Resources
sections.instruction: List documents, links, recordings, examples, or tools referenced during the workshop

sections.title: Follow-up Actions
sections.instruction: List practice assignments, feedback requests, next sessions, and owners
